assessments.reasoning: The instrument allows distinguishing de jure vs de facto female-headed households through marital status (Sección 1, Pregunta 7), presence/absence of spouse (Pregunta 5 line ID), and remittance reception (Sección 6 Parte E Pregunta 2). Unpartnered mother-child units can be uniquely identified within any household structure using Pregunta 5 (line IDs for spouse and mother) combined with marital status in Pregunta 7 and the roster structure. Women-maintained households or units can be identified through the individual income reporting for all members 10 and older in Sección 6 Parte E Pregunta 1, allowing the determination of the main income provider regardless of who is reported as household head. However, consumption and production are measured only at the aggregate household level (e.g., Sección 7 Parte B Pregunta 8 and Sección 8 Parte D Pregunta 10) and care work activities are not measured, so mother-child units cannot be linked to their own consumption, production, or care activity.
